tei:div.tei:p: 569) dus mchod gtong lugs/ tshes lnga la thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal ma rang grol/ tshes brgyad la dpal chen 'dus pa/ tshes bcu la rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ tshes bcu bzhi la dpal chen/ tshes bco lnga la rig 'dus tshe sgrub/ tshes bcu dgu la dpal chen/ tshes nyer gnyis la tshe bdag tshes nyer lnga la yum bka'/ tshes nyer dgu la dpal chen/ tshes bcu la 'od chog sman chog rtsa gsum las byang*/ ༈ thams cad la/ las byang bsnyen bstod tshar mtshams*/ ma mgon nas gser skyems yan/ na raka skong bshags/ tshogs byinarlabs/ spyan 'dren mchod bshags sgral gsum mthar/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu'i/ mdor na= mgor/ ting 'dzin sprul pa'i brgya/ rtogs pas bdag bsgral= brgya/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i= brgya/ sangs rgyas phrin las= brgya/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= brgya/ bde chen chos sku= brgya/ 'jig rten 'phrul gyi= brgya/ phyogs phyogs= brgya/ gter srung rma gnyan= brgya/ mdor na rab 'byams= drang lhag bskul/ chad brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod bshags dngos grub/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas/ yang na tshes bcu dgu la dngos grub rol mtsho gtang ngo*/ 570)
